sourceSummary.zh: 沃尔夫把教育、跨学科创新与人性联系起来，解释为什么看好技术进步，同时警惕投资和社会中的行为弱点。
sourceSummary.en: Wolfe links education, interdisciplinary innovation and human behavior to explain his optimism about technology alongside skepticism about recurring human weaknesses.

heading.zh: 为什么访谈从一所学校开始
heading.en: Why the conversation begins with a school

paragraphs.zh: 主持人吉姆·奥肖内西先问 Coney Island Prep。沃尔夫从自己在布鲁克林成长的经历回答：家庭的期待、同伴的影响和教育环境，改变了他能够看到的道路。他谈学校时强调的不是抽象的成功学，而是让原本缺少机会的孩子接触另一组可能性。导读认为，这个开场为后面的创投讨论提供了一条线索：能力的出现，需要环境让人看见并发展它。
paragraphs.en: Jim O’Shaughnessy opens with Coney Island Prep. Wolfe answers through his Brooklyn upbringing, describing how family expectations, peers and education affected the paths he could imagine. His account concerns access to possibilities rather than a generic success formula. The guide sees a connection to the later venture discussion: ability needs an environment in which it can be recognized and developed.

heading.zh: 科学的机会经常出现在学科交界处
heading.en: Scientific opportunity often sits between disciplines

paragraphs.zh: 谈到技术时，沃尔夫看重把不同领域的工具组合起来。他举出自然语言处理用于科学文献和药物研究的方向，并把这种跨界思考与芒格式的知识连接联系起来。重点不只是某个热门标签，而是一种工具进入另一领域后，能否改变原来做不到、做不快或做不起的事情。这样的观察把“未来很大”拆成了更具体的能力变化。
paragraphs.en: On technology, Wolfe emphasizes combining tools from different fields. He discusses language-processing methods entering scientific literature and drug research, relating this to Munger’s habit of connecting disciplines. The issue is how a tool changes what another field can achieve, how quickly and at what cost. This turns a broad story about the future into a more concrete account of changing capabilities.

heading.zh: 发射能力之外，还有一整条产业链
heading.en: Look beyond launch vehicles to an ecosystem

paragraphs.zh: 他用太空产业展开这个思路：发射成本和能力变化后，不只是火箭企业受影响，卫星物流、通信、成像、推进和制造也可能出现新的经营空间。提到 Varda 等项目时，他是在解释基础设施如何为后续企业打开条件。导读认为，研究这类机会需要继续追问：哪一项瓶颈已经松动，哪一项仍然存在，以及谁真正能够把新增能力卖给客户。
paragraphs.en: Space provides a detailed example. Changes in launch capabilities can affect satellite logistics, communications, imaging, propulsion and manufacturing as well as rocket companies. In discussing ventures such as Varda, he describes infrastructure enabling further businesses. The guide identifies the next research questions as which constraints have eased, which remain and who can sell the resulting capability to customers.

heading.zh: 技术乐观与人性怀疑可以同时成立
heading.en: Technical optimism can coexist with skepticism about behavior

paragraphs.zh: 沃尔夫把自己对科学技术的长期乐观，与对人性的怀疑并列。他看到工程师持续改进工具与生产方式，也看到人们反复受到身份、群体和情绪的影响。这里不能把主持人随后关于市场优势的评论都归给嘉宾；双方是在相互呼应的基础上展开讨论。导读认为，技术进步和证券价格并没有必然同步的关系，这也是理解这种乐观时需要保留的区分。
paragraphs.en: Wolfe pairs optimism about science and technology with skepticism about human nature. Engineers improve tools and production while people remain susceptible to identity, groups and emotion. The host’s subsequent comments about market advantage belong to the host, even where they resonate with Wolfe’s point. The guide distinguishes progress in capabilities from the path of security prices.

heading.zh: 机会变多，不意味着风险消失
heading.en: More possibilities do not eliminate risk

paragraphs.zh: 他也明确把自己资助的早期项目形容为具有很高的投机性和风险。谈低利率、资产上涨与参与市场的机会时，他同时注意到谁拥有资产、谁因此受益。这让访谈的态度比单纯赞美创新更复杂：科学值得投入，社会机会需要扩展，而资本市场中的热情仍然需要受到判断的约束。导读认为，这几条线合起来，才构成了这场访谈较完整的思想轮廓。
paragraphs.en: He explicitly describes the early ventures he funds as speculative and risky. Discussing low rates, rising assets and market access, he also asks who owns assets and benefits from appreciation. The conversation therefore goes beyond celebrating innovation: science merits support, opportunity can be broadened and financial enthusiasm still needs judgment. The guide reads these themes together rather than reduce the interview to technological optimism.
